data.name: UnknownCommand
data.value: {0} is not a command here. Start the line with // to send it as words.

data.name: Welcome
data.value: Add an IRC server to chat in its channels from Group Chat and with its people from Messages.

data.name: PickServer
data.value: Pick a server on the left.

data.name: PlainWarning
data.value: Without encryption anyone on the way can read everything, and no password is sent (except to this computer).

data.name: NickNote
data.value: If it is taken, the same with _ or a number after it is tried.

data.name: OnConnectNote
data.value: One per line, as a network asks of its users: /msg, /mode and the like.

data.name: ChannelsAreInGroupChat
data.value: Channels are in Group Chat, and conversations with people in Messages.

data.name: ProblemNoEncryption
data.value: Not connected: a password is only sent over an encrypted connection. Turn on TLS for this server.

data.name: ProblemRefused
data.value: Not connected: the server turned the connection away.

data.name: HistoryKept
data.value: This server keeps history: what is said while you are away comes back when you reconnect.

data.name: HistoryNone
data.value: This server keeps no history: what is said while you are not connected is not seen here.

data.name: NotInChannel
data.value: Not in this channel right now.

data.name: NoChannelsListed
data.value: The server listed no channels. Type a channel's name to join it.

data.name: ConfirmBan
data.value: Ban {0} from {2}? This bans {1}, and puts them out.

data.name: NeedNick
data.value: Type a nickname: one word, not starting with # or :.

data.name: NeedPassword
data.value: Type the password for this way of logging in.

data.name: ConfirmDelete
data.value: Remove {0}? Its channels and saved messages go with it.

data.name: ProblemNickname
data.value: Not connected: the server does not accept this nickname. Choose another under Edit.

data.name: CannotRedact
data.value: This server does not let messages be taken back.

data.name: ChannelSettingsNote
data.value: The channel's modes, as this server has them. Changes are sent when you press Save; the lists change as soon as you add or remove a line. The server refuses what your rank does not allow, and says so in Group Chat.

data.name: ChannelSettingsNotRead
data.value: The server has not said yet how this channel is set, so what is ticked may be short of it.

data.name: ModeListBansNote
data.value: Whoever matches one of these cannot join (+b).

data.name: ModeListExceptionsNote
data.value: Whoever matches one of these can join even if a ban matches them too (+e).

data.name: ModeListInvitesNote
data.value: Whoever matches one of these can join an invite-only channel without an invitation (+I).

data.name: ModeKeyTip
data.value: The channel key: only people who give it can join.

data.name: ModeKeyKept
data.value: The channel has a password, which is never shown. Type a new one to change it.

data.name: ModeKeyWillChange
data.value: Saving sets this as the password to join.

data.name: ModeKeyWillGo
data.value: Saving takes the password off: anyone can join.

data.name: ModeKeyNeeded
data.value: Type the password people will need to join.

data.name: ModeKeyNoSpaces
data.value: A channel password cannot have spaces in it.

data.name: ModeNeedsValue
data.value: {0}: give a value, or untick it.

data.name: ModeInviteOnlyTip
data.value: Only people invited, or on the invite exceptions, can join.

data.name: ModeModeratedTip
data.value: Only operators and people with voice can speak.

data.name: ModeNoOutsideTip
data.value: Only people in the channel can send messages to it.

data.name: ModeTopicLockTip
data.value: Others cannot change the channel's topic.

data.name: ModeSecretTip
data.value: Not shown in the server's channel list, nor to people outside it.

data.name: ModePrivateTip
data.value: An older kind of secret: shown in lists, but not who is in it.

data.name: ModeRegisteredOnlyTip
data.value: Only people logged in to an account can join.

data.name: ModeRegisteredSpeakTip
data.value: People not logged in to an account can join but not speak.

data.name: ModeNoCtcpTip
data.value: Client requests (version, ping) to the channel are blocked. /me still works.

data.name: ModeNoColourTip
data.value: Messages with colour codes are blocked or stripped.

data.name: ModeLimitTip
data.value: Once this many are in, nobody else can join.

data.name: ModeOtherTip
data.value: A setting only this server has. Its meaning is in the server's own help.
